verdict.rationale: Paystack is a payments platform, and a platform like this could plausibly offer user-configurable background automations, so the axis applies. The pack shows no such feature. Recurring payment collection is a specific billing capability, not a general automation the user sets up. Automatic payment routing and fraud systems are internal platform behaviours rather than user-defined automations. The API is only a developer building block for constructing automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
